evidence.detail: matchup_cards, _ = cs.load_cards() — no all_legal=True, so only cards that appear in _card_stats (played competitively) are returned
all_legal=True switches from_clause to '_legal_cards LEFT JOIN _card_stats', including unplayed-but-legal cards
preaggregate_legal_cards() populates _legal_cards with every card in the current season's legal list, run at post-rotation

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/controllers/metagame.py:161, change `cs.load_cards()` to `cs.load_cards(all_legal=True)`. This switches the underlying query to use `_legal_cards LEFT JOIN _card_stats`, which includes all currently legal cards even if they have zero competitive plays, exactly as other card-list endpoints do.
triage.notes: The all_legal flag is already used by the /cards/ endpoint in the same way; this is just a missing parameter on the matchups card list.
